title: Clickety Cuttlefish
statement: Drifting through a twilight grotto of stacked slate ledges and softly glowing sea-ferns, this pint-sized cephalopod ripples with shifting constellations of amber and violet light whenever a visitor leans close to the glass. An endlessly curious curator, it spends its days gathering bits of tumbled sea-glass in its tentacles and rhythmically tapping them into intricate, ever-changing mosaics across the sandy floor.
